newsitem.title: FINLAND: POHJOLA FALLS ON WEAK OVERALL SENTIMENT.
newsitem.headline: POHJOLA FALLS ON WEAK OVERALL SENTIMENT.

text.p: Shares in Finnish insurance group Pohjola fell on Wednesday on uncertainty on the bond market and depressed sentiment overall on the Helsinki bourse, brokers said.
At 1430/1130 GMT, Pohjola traded at 158.00, down 5.50 markka or 3.36 percent and trade was a relatively lively 13.5 million markka.
"Pohjola sometimes just rises enormously and sometimes falls, one broker said. "It reacts the overall sentiment."
Another referred to jitters on the bond market and said interest in the share was both domestic and international.
